description: An encrypted record of one Telescope search attempt, written into the explorer's OWN repo when the sponsor turned on the search-history archive (search.auditPubKeyJwk present) and the explorer has an account. The whole payload — query, whether it was blocked, the tier, and the precise time (at, epoch ms) — is sealed to the sponsor's audit public key (a libsodium-style sealed box: ECDH P-256 → HKDF → AES-256-GCM; see docs/trail-map-search.md). On the public AppView it is inert; only the sponsor's private key can open it. `createdAt` is the only cleartext field and is rounded to the UTC DAY (00:00:00Z): a public reader learns that a search happened on a day, never the precise time (sealed as at) nor what. Retention: the device keeps the last 30 days / 500.

enc.description: The sealed payload — nothing readable without the sponsor's private key.

tier.description: Trust distance from the tended garden: green = inside the garden, blue = one hop beyond it, black = the open network. This is a trust rating, not a content-maturity rating. Cleartext so Patrol tooling and third-party audits can read the trust context a search ran under, without opening the sealed payload.

createdAt.description: The UTC DAY the search happened, rounded to 00:00:00Z — the only cleartext field. The precise time rides sealed inside `enc` as `at`.

sealed.description: A sealed box: ephemeral ECDH public key + AES-GCM IV + ciphertext, all base64.

epk.description: Ephemeral ECDH P-256 public key (JWK) for this message.
